text:
rachel: following up from the recent OOM cluster sweep. creating a short remediation checklist so owners + checkpoints are clear. please add yourself to the frag-ops-checklist by EOD.
rachel: checklist link: https://redwood.internal/frag-ops-checklist (add ticket link + ETA in your row)
tomas: i'll own the per-shard soft-limit experiment and the routing fallback prototype. ETA: initial canary in 72h.
ivy: i'll take the allocation-profiling + flamegraph artifacts and run a full-night trace. ETA: 48h.
infra-bot: pattern-detected: KV fragmentation spikes precede OOM by median 7m 12s across clusters. incidents linked: INC-5401, INC-5418
sre-tom: i'll own the dashboard + alert gating (p95 delta + frag_ratio). will add a panel for soft-evict counts and alloc slope. ETA: 3d.
ivy: profiler quick notes from last extract:
ivy: ```
# profiler sample
kv_alloc_hot: 29.6%
kv_insert_path: 21.0%
slab_alloc: 11.4%
```
tomas: soft-limit sketch:
- soft_limit_pct = 80
- on soft: mark shard degraded, start async compaction, route 50% of new sessions to spare pool
- if frag_ratio increases after 3m -> escalate and route 100% away
- hard_limit_pct = 95 -> refuse new writes + schedule immediate drain
sre-tom: caution: routing away may spike tail latency on receivers. i'll add a canary guard that throttles route-away to 30% at first and scale to 100% if compaction shows progress.
rachel: owners recap: tomas=limits+routing, ivy=profiling+artifacts, sre-tom=dashboard+alerts. i'll coordinate the decision checkpoint and external comms.
ivy: repro harness i'll run (small/large key churn) — sketch below:
ivy: ```
# repro workload
for i in range(0, 25000):
  put(key=f"s_{i}", value=random_bytes(200))
  if i % 350 == 0:
    put(key=f"L_{i}", value=random_bytes(900000))
  sleep(4ms)
```
tomas: canary plan: roll soft-limit behavior to 3 nodes, run synthetic workload from ivy for 6h, collect frag_ratio and alloc slope every 30s. decision point after 48h of stable metrics.
infra-bot: alert: OOM surge on canary-west at 2025-01-10T02:11:05Z -> 4 nodes affected -> linked INC-6110
sre-tom: dashboard panels planned: frag_ratio trend (1m), kv_alloc_rate, p95/p99 overlay when soft-evict events occur. will tag alerts with checklist row id.
ivy: i'll push flamegraphs + pprof artifacts to s3://frag-artifacts/canary-180500 and tag them with the canary id.
tomas: i'll open RED-4991 for routing fallback with acceptance criteria and rollback plan.
rachel: timeline check: profiling run in 48h, canary in 72h, decision meeting next Fri. sound right?
ivy: aligned.
tomas: aligned.
sre-tom: aligned.
rachel: final asks: 1) owners add ticket links + ETAs to the checklist doc; 2) post artifacts to the frag-artifacts bucket with canary tag; 3) drop a 1-line weekly status in the checklist row before the decision meeting. i'll close this thread once the checklist is updated. :white_check_mark:
filename_note: KV OOM remediation checklist owners and canary plan
